delacct.k1: Advice records, for seven years, with your personal details removed
delacct.k2: Work you completed on farms owned by someone else, attributed to a removed user
delacct.r1: Your name, mobile number and email
delacct.r2: Your farms, boundaries and crop history
delacct.r4: Your subscription, at its next renewal
delacct.timing: We create a deletion request and complete it within 30 days.
delacct.title: Delete my account
delfarm.body: Every plot, boundary, crop cycle, task and report for this farm is lost. This cannot be undone.
delfarm.second: This farm has more than 90 days of history, so we will ask you again in 24 hours before anything is removed.
delfarm.title: Delete {name}?
delplot.body: Its boundary, crop history and measurements go with it. This cannot be undone.
delplot.title: Delete {name}?
demo.addfarm: Adding a real farm needs an account. Everything else in the demo works.
demo.convert.body: Nothing you do here is saved, and the data is not from a real farm.
demo.convert.body2: Create an account to add your own farm and get advice for it.
demo.convert.title: This is a demo
demo.exit.body: The demo is not saved. Closing it takes you back to the start.
demo.exit.title: Leave the demo?
e2.notrouting: A straight line and a distance — not turn-by-turn directions.
e2.photostamp: Each photo carries its position, the time, this task and who took it.
e3.onlyaccess: Only people with access to this farm are listed. They are told in their own language.
e3.prefilled: Filled in from the advice for {plots}. Add an assignee and save.
e3.title: Create a task
e4.offline: Offline — this will send when you have signal
e4.title: Mark as done
e6.location: Your position is recorded with this observation
e6.title: Field observation
e7.notcertain: An automated identification is a suggestion, not a diagnosis. Confirm it on the ground before you act.
e7.title: Photo disease check
f1.note: Reports are produced on our servers as PDF, in the language you ask for, with Wafra branding only. Tabular reports also export to Excel.
f1.serverside: Produced on our servers, never assembled on your phone, and carrying Wafra branding only.
f1.title: Reports
f10.clear.sub: Your photos and unsent work are not touched.
f10.encrypted: Everything saved on this phone, including imagery and queued photos, is encrypted.
f10.evict: When the limit is reached we remove the oldest imagery first. Your photos and completed work are never removed.
f10.nothing: Everything on this phone has been sent.
f10.resetdemo.sub: Mockup only — puts every farm, task and advice item back as it started.
f10.title: Data and storage
f10.whatiskept: What we keep on your phone
f10.wifi.sub: A task you completed more than 24 hours ago uploads on any connection regardless.
f11.appendonly: This log can only be added to. Nobody, including you, can edit or delete an entry.
f11.owneronly: The activity log is available to farm owners.
f11.title: Activity log
f12.title: Help and user guide
f12.updated: The guide is kept on our servers, so it improves without you updating the app.
f13.config: Our contact details come from our servers, so they can change without you updating the app.
f13.hours: Sunday to Thursday, 08:00–17:00. Arabic and English.
f13.title: Contact Wafra
f14.phonenote: Your mobile number is your account. Contact us to change it.
f14.photonotice: Photographs you take record where you were and when. Your supervisor and the farm owner can see them. You can ask us to delete your personal data at any time.
f14.title: My profile
f2.scoped: Access is granted per farm. Someone can be a supervisor here and have no access to another farm.
f2.supervisor: As a supervisor you can invite workers, and only to farms you already have access to.
f2.title: Team and access
f3.qrnote: Single use, expires in 7 days, and carries only the role and farms you chose.
f3.scope.hint: They will see only the farms you tick.
f3.title: Invite
f4.remove.sub: Takes effect at once. Their completed work stays on the record.
f4.rolenote: A role change takes effect on their next request, not at their next login.
f5.combined: You hold one Complete plan covering both. It has a single price and a single renewal date — never two subscriptions.
f5.downgrade: To move to a single family you would first need to archive your {n} tree farms. We will show you which ones when you try.
f5.expired.body: You can still see your farms, boundaries, history and past reports. New analytics, advice and task creation are paused. We keep your data for 12 months.
f5.invoice: Need an invoice or an annual contract?
f5.manage: Manage billing in the App Store
f5.serverside: What you can see and do is decided by our servers on every request, never by this phone.
f5.title: Subscription
f5.trial.body: After that you keep your farms, boundaries and history, but new analytics and advice stop until you subscribe.
f6.note: Plan order is always Basic, then Pro, then Advanced.
f6.title: Compare plans
f7.shared.sub: Signs you out after 12 hours and asks again when the app opens. Use this on a phone several people share.
f7.title: Settings
f8.numerals.sub: Western numerals are the norm in commercial agriculture across the region.
f8.title: Language and region
f8.translation.note: Where a phrase is not yet translated the app falls back to English and records the gap. A user never sees a raw key.
f9.cannotoff: Always on · you can change the channel
f9.cap: We send at most 6 messages a day. Anything beyond that arrives as one summary.
f9.language: Every message reaches you in your own language, whoever sent it.
f9.quiet.note: Severe weather alerts and urgent advice always come through.
f9.title: Notifications
forgot.body: We will send a code to your mobile number. Enter it, then choose a new password.
forgot.title: Reset your password
legal.t1: Everything this app tells you about your crop is decision support. It is advice, not a prescription.
legal.t2: You remain responsible for what is applied on your land. Complying with local pesticide regulation rests with whoever applies the product.
legal.t3: Satellite measurements can be affected by cloud, dust and the timing of a pass. Where we cannot measure something we say so rather than estimating it.
legal.t4: Subscriptions are billed through the App Store or Google Play and renew until you cancel there.
log.title: How this was worked out
log.writeonce: Every recommendation is written to a log the moment it is generated, before anyone sees it. The log can be added to but never changed or deleted, and it is kept for seven years.
login.biometric: Biometric unlock is available on this device.
measure.note: The plain name is used everywhere in the app. The technical name appears in the map legend and in reports.
new.obs.sub: A photo and a note from where you are standing
new.task.sub: Send a job to someone on your team
new.title: What would you like to add?
notif.1s: 693 m³. Soil moisture is low and 44 °C is forecast.
notif.deeplink: Every message opens the exact task, advice or report it is about — even from a cold start.
notif.title: Notifications
offline.body: You need {what}. Everything you capture in the field still saves on your phone.
offline.boundary: You need a connection to change a boundary. Everything else on this plot still works offline.
offline.need.task: You need a connection to assign a task. Your other work still saves on the phone.
offline.title: You are offline
plan.iap: In the real app this opens Apple In-App Purchase or Google Play Billing. Payment never happens anywhere else.
qr.title: Scan a code
qr.tree: Point the camera at the tag on a tree.
search.hint: Try a farm name, a plot like P-04, a crop like alfalfa, or a tree ID like T-2841.
treemenu.override.sub: Mark it as replanted, removed or misidentified
upgrade.title: {name} is part of the {plan} plan
